newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 25.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Monday, the U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average surged 100.46 points to 6,905.25.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 1.66 points to 1,214.60. But fears of the impact of an expected interest rate hike in the U.S. on Tuesday continued to dog the market, said analysts.
* Malaysian car distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasioanal Bhd said it has sold its stake in a Singapore-based property developer.
